codeReview.summary: The feature is narrowly scoped and mostly correct: the cache key now tracks resolved native font size so display-scale-only changes reuse logical layouts while derived font-size changes invalidate reuse, and the added TextSystemTests cover the required width/line-break/truncation cases. I found one non-blocking correctness risk in the span cache-boundary implementation.

issues.description: The cache key reduces span layout inputs to a single Int fingerprint via makeSpansFingerprint(). Because that digest is lossy, two distinct span configurations can alias and incorrectly reuse the same cached logical layout. For a feature whose contract is real cache boundaries, the key should keep exact span-boundary data (or a structurally equatable span key) instead of treating a hash digest as semantic identity.

summary: Reviewed the feature record, worker transcript skeleton, handoff, graphics-scene skill, shared-state docs, and commit a5e04b0. The resolved-font-size cache fix and focused tests match the feature contract overall, but there is a non-blocking follow-up: span cache boundaries are still represented by a lossy fingerprint rather than exact span identity.
